idea-plugin.name: Proto to HTTP
idea-plugin.description:
Generate .http files from Protocol Buffer (.proto) files for gRPC testing in JetBrains HTTP Client.

Features:
  • Generate HTTP requests from proto service definitions
  • Support for imports and Well-Known Types
  • Bulk generation for entire directories
  • Configurable output directory and host settings

Usage:
  • Right-click on a .proto file → Generate HTTP File
  • Right-click on a folder → Generate HTTP Files (Bulk)
  • Configure settings in Settings → Tools → Proto2HTTP
